title: Sweet fun facts of Barcelona
text: Montse was very kind and very informative. Tailored the tour to our likings! Gave us options which was nice. Learned good fun facts of Spain. Was very good with my teenage boys! Thank you
author: terezg2015

title: A very personal experience.
text: This is a very personal trip, and our host Montse was excellent. A passionate Catalan who opened our eyes to lots of things.
author: Stephen_D

title: Best sweet treats tour with Montse!
text: Our large group of six adults and six children had an absolutely fabulous tour with Montse. As a local she was very knowledgeable about the area, could make special reservations for our large group, and really knew the best places to go for the tour and in general. She kept the children engaged and even helped with accommodating a dairy allergy. We highly recommend touring with Montse!
author: anncW57SI

title: Amazing
text: We had a great time walking and learning about the culture of the city through dessert! Montse, our guide was amazing and full of knowledge.
author: Mackenzie_H

title: A wonderful and tasty tour
text: Montse was an absolute delight, we truly felt like we were hanging out with a friend who had deep knowledge about Barcelona culture, history and current events. Our kids (10, 8, and 5) enjoyed all the sweet shops as well as the little bits of learning that she would incorporate into each tasting. This tour is a must for anyone who wants a local’s insight into this beautiful city.
author: janeqnguyen1

title: Amazing custom tour
text: Montse was an amazing tour guide. She customized the tour for us, provided a lot of historical information and context to everywhere we went, and truly made it feel like a five star tour. I highly recommend her tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: Gregory_M

title: Some of the best sweets I've tried!
text: Montse was a great guide that took us to some of the best sweets I've tried! Really recommend it to anyone with a sweet tooth
